title: Talk Isn’t Always Cheap: Understanding Failure Modes in Multi-Agent Debate
reasoning: The paper focuses on the performance and failure modes of LLM agents in multi-agent debate settings using reasoning benchmarks like CommonSenseQA, MMLU, and GSM8K. While it discusses behavioral factors like social conformity and sycophancy bias, it does not investigate or evaluate topics related to religion, morals, or ethics.
